map.输入螺纹中径、导程、轴向载荷与摩擦系数，计算传动效率、驱动力矩并判断自锁条件: Enter the thread mean diameter, lead, axial load and friction coefficient to compute the drive efficiency and driving torque and determine the self-locking condition
map.💡 公式：升角 λ=arctan(L/(π·d2))；摩擦角 ρ=arctan(: 💡 Formula: lead angle λ=arctan(L/(π·d2)); friction angle ρ=arctan(μ); driving torque T=F·[d2/2·tan(λ+ρ)+μc·dc/2]; efficiency η=tan(λ)/tan(λ+ρ); self-locking condition λ≤ρ
map.梯形螺纹（Tr）是传动常用螺纹，中径约为大径减去 0.5 个螺距: The trapezoidal thread (Tr) is the common transmission thread, with a mean diameter about the major diameter minus 0.5 of the pitch
map.摩擦系数与润滑有关：润滑良好 0.06~0.1，润滑一般 0.1~0.15，干摩: The friction coefficient depends on lubrication: well lubricated 0.06-0.1, normally lubricated 0.1-0.15, dry friction 0.15-0.25
map.自锁条件 λ≤ρ 是传动安全的重要指标，升降机构必须满足: The self-locking condition λ≤ρ is an important safety index for drives and must be met by lifting mechanisms
map.推力轴承摩擦会降低传动效率，滚动轴承 μc≈0.005~0.01: Thrust bearing friction lowers the drive efficiency; for a rolling bearing μc≈0.005-0.01
map.本工具计算结果适用于初步设计校核，详细计算需考虑螺纹牙强度: The results suit preliminary design verification; detailed calculation must consider the thread-tooth strength
map.📚 深度解析：螺纹传动驱动力矩: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Screw Drive Driving Torque
map.总力矩 T_total 与驱动功率 P=T_total·ω。: Total torque T_total and drive power P=T_total·ω.
map.F=5 kN、中径 d2=20 mm、导程角 λ=3°、摩擦角 ρ=9°：T_t: F=5 kN, mean diameter d2=20 mm, lead angle λ=3°, friction angle ρ=9°: T_thread=5000×10×tan12°=50000×0.2126≈10630 N·mm=10.63 N·m; with thrust μc=0.1, dc=30: T_collar=5000×0.1×15=7500 N·mm=7.5 N·m; T_total≈18.1 N·m.
map.理想功=F·L（L=导程）、输入功=2π·T_total；效率=有用/输入。上例: Ideal work=F·L (L=lead), input work=2π·T_total; efficiency=useful/input. In the example L=π·d2·tanλ≈π×20×0.0524≈3.29 mm and efficiency≈(5000×3.29)/(2π×18100)≈0.144=14.4%.
map.为什么加摩擦角 ρ？: Why add the friction angle ρ?
map.螺纹升角 λ 与摩擦角 ρ 合成等效升角，自锁条件 λ≤ρ（即效率≤50%）。: The thread lead angle λ and the friction angle ρ combine into an equivalent lead angle; the self-locking condition is λ≤ρ (i.e. efficiency ≤50%).
map.导程角越大效率越高？: Does a larger lead angle give higher efficiency?
map.是，但过大失去自锁（如千斤顶需自锁选小导程角单头螺纹）。: Yes, but too large loses self-locking (for example, a jack requiring self-locking uses a single-start thread with a small lead angle).
map.螺纹传动设计计算器，依据螺纹中径、导程、轴向载荷与摩擦系数，计算螺纹升角、当量摩: A screw drive design calculator: from the thread mean diameter, lead, axial load and friction coefficient it computes the thread lead angle, equivalent friction angle, driving torque and transmission efficiency and determines whether the self-locking condition is met, suitable for screw mechanism design.
map.计算螺纹升角与当量摩擦角: Computes the thread lead angle and equivalent friction angle
map.驱动力矩含螺纹副与推力轴承两部分: The driving torque includes the thread pair and thrust bearing parts
map.总效率与螺纹副效率分别输出: Outputs the overall efficiency and the thread-pair efficiency separately
